timeline.quote: It could be your measure. If you march against the other heirs.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol marks the longhouse ridge and the son's warriors march off; Nicol explains humans are easy to manipulate through hate, envy and fear.
timeline.quote: Humans are riddled with hate and envy and fear and greed.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin realizes Nicol caused the earlier murder and plans to manipulate his mind too, and he feels his twin's betrayal.
timeline.quote: He wanted to use me for his own ends, because he had never truly cared for me at all.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin is torn into the space between planes and then lands on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: being torn from the only place I had never known and flung into the space between the planes.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin ends his story, and Yasova says she witnessed Ugin's death eighteen years ago and another dragon who vanished in golden light.
timeline.quote: Eighteen years ago, I witnessed a battle in the sky that ended with the death of Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals Bolas killed Ugin and that she was used as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
timeline.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: In the story, the young dragon king Nicol sets the human heirs against each other, loses his brother Ugin to a blast of sorcery, and rules as a just king.
timeline.quote: In the course of the war, his brother was swept away into nothingness by a blast of human sorcery

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king retreats into a canyon with a third of his army and plans a trap, thinking of Ugin and his search for a disintegration spell.
timeline.quote: For generations he had toiled in concert with his academy of sorcerers to recover or devise a magic that could replicate Ugin's disappearance.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party reaches the gateway to Ugin's grave, where hedrons cover the Spirit Dragon's bones, and Yasova calls for the group that camps there.
timeline.quote: Grandmother calls them hedrons. They protect the Spirit Dragon's bones.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya, saying Ugin is calling her, slips through a narrow cleft and Naiva follows, resisting a whisper telling her to abandon her twin.
timeline.quote: No. Death is more complicated than that. If you won't come, I'm going alone.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva and Baishya fall into Ugin's memories by touching hands inside the hedron.
timeline.quote: The magic of the hedrons opened a gate mind to mind.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin hovers above still waters between planes, realizing he has walked between worlds, then arrives on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: This must be one of the planes of which Te Ju Ki speaks.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin shifts back to Dominaria and finds the birth mountain now holds a city and temple with curved horns, which tells him Nicol rules there.
timeline.quote: He recognizes the shape of the curved horns.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin travels among many planes, then decides to find Nicol again, having mastered planeswalking.
timeline.quote: By now, he has mastered planeswalking.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin appears between the warring armies of Nicol and Arcades on Jamuraa and demands they stop.
timeline.quote: Nicol! Arcades! You must put a stop to this! It's wrong!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol, thinking Ugin dead, blasts him with fire before Ugin convinces him; Nicol leaves his army to take Ugin to his domain.
timeline.quote: It will be. Come see what I have accomplished. Come, Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin confronts Nicol atop the birth mountain about his mind-manipulation and the pointlessness of his conquests.
timeline.quote: You tried to influence me with that trick of the mind.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he is a planeswalker, and Nicol asks to be taught.
timeline.quote: I am a Planeswalker now.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin cannot explain the spark; Nicol calls him a liar and a coward, and Ugin leaves in fury and grief.
timeline.quote: You can't tell me, can you?

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva wakes inside the hedron, and Yasova arrives and says Ugin is not dead but trying to communicate through dreams.
timeline.quote: It seems Ugin is not dead after all. But not awake either.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas says he wants Ugin, admits he killed him once before, and tries to enlist Naiva to destroy him for all eternity.
timeline.quote: That's what I thought the first time I killed him, but he wasn't dead after all.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers Naiva rule of the world if she tells him where Ugin is, and Naiva asks why he hates his twin.
timeline.quote: Why do you hate Ugin? He's your twin.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas denies that Ugin is his twin, calling it a story Ugin spread to share his glory.
timeline.quote: That's just a story he put about, trying to grab for a share of my glory and my triumph.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas begins his account, claiming he woke first and woke Ugin, who flew only because he taught him.
timeline.quote: In this way he discovered flight or, I should say, I taught him that flight is what we dragons are made for.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he avenged his sister's death on the humans while Ugin lost his nerve, then Ugin fled, vanishing.
timeline.quote: And so, he fled. He vanished, there one moment and then as if with the blink of the eye and a ripple through the air . . . GONE.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
timeline.quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas says Ugin mocked him atop the birth mountain and vanished, and Bolas felt rage and envy.
timeline.quote: In a ripple of warm wind, he was gone.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he visited hundreds of worlds, found no other planeswalker, and returned home to share this with Ugin.
timeline.quote: I was the first among all sapient creatures to discover the possibility of traveling between planes.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he found Ugin floating in the Meditation Realm and that Ugin attacked him, leading to a long struggle across the planes.
timeline.quote: He attacked, viciously and without warning, all raw fury and malignant resentment.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed Ugin in the Meditation Realm in self-defense, and the shockwaves hurled him back to Dominaria on Madara.
timeline.quote: There, purely in self-defense, I killed him.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas threatens Naiva, tells her Ugin plagued him later with a plan to trap him on Ixalan, and learns she says Ugin's bones lie beneath the hedrons.
timeline.quote: He has plagued me ever since, most recently with a misbegotten plan to trap me on Ixalan by means of a magical artifact.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons' purpose is that the Eldrazi can be imprisoned; Jace asks how that worked last time.
timeline.quote: "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."

citation.text: Hedron Archive (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yasova confesses she helped Bolas track Ugin and cast a spell that turned fledgling dragons against him, after being promised an end to dragons.
timeline.quote: I helped Bolas track down Ugin because he promised me an end to dragons on Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova argues that destroying the hedrons would destroy Ugin's essence, the soul of Tarkir, so they must resist Bolas.
timeline.quote: I do not believe Bolas can destroy the hedrons.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva takes Baishya's hand and enters Ugin's memories in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: After a decisive nod at Grandmother, she took hold of Baishya's hand.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin, in the Meditation Realm, regrets that Nicol was not overjoyed at his return and wonders whether his departure was his fault.
timeline.quote: Nicol had succumbed to the worst in himself

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas attacks Ugin in the Meditation Realm, accusing him of hoarding the planes' knowledge and abandoning him.
timeline.quote: You hoarded the knowledge of the planes to yourself.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin flees through Zendikar, Kephalai and Ravnica with Bolas in pursuit, wounded by his venomous magic.
timeline.quote: From bustling Kephalai to growing Ravnica and on and on, he flees with Nicol breathing down his neck

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin realizes Nicol will never stop unless he thinks him dead, and accepts death in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: With a sigh, Ugin accepts his death. He lets go.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas kills Ugin, who falls into the waters; the cataclysm drains the realm and flings Bolas to Madara.
timeline.quote: With a mighty splash, Ugin falls into the still waters.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: The realm refills and a dragon, reborn from the waters, resolves to protect the planes and departs.
timeline.quote: Ugin has a lot to do if he means to protect the planes.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Ugin asks a winged ally in a glass city for help to trap Bolas, planning to lure him to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will lure him to Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Memory: Bolas arrives on Tarkir and, turning the dragons against their progenitor, kills Ugin, who falls and carves the canyon.
timeline.quote: Bolas turns the dragons of Tarkir against their own progenitor

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
timeline.quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Ugin identifies the gem linking Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to Bolas's downfall.
timeline.quote: Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

citation.text: Finale of Revelation (War of the Spark Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria, Rat helps find Liliana, defeat an imposter, and persuade Kaya to let Liliana live.
timeline.quote: Rat helped convince Kaya to let Liliana live

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Bolas's defeat, Jace hides with an illusion that Ugin took Bolas's body away.
timeline.quote: At Ugin's request, Jace used an illusion to hide the fact that Ugin had planeswalked away with Bolas' body

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace hides that Ugin took Bolas's body.
timeline.quote: Jace used an illusion to hide the fact that Ugin had taken Bolas' body

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin and Bolas fight for days, years and generations before returning to the Meditation Realm, where Bolas kills Ugin; the resulting waves fling Bolas to Madara.
timeline.quote: where Bolas killed Ugin

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Confrontation of the twins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The wrecked plane restores itself, and Ugin is reborn from its waters.
timeline.quote: The dragon was reborn and floated above a once again dry seabed beneath the luminous sky.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Confrontation of the twins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Bolas's faked death, Ugin secretly takes the mortal Bolas to the realm, reveals the Spirit-Gem and strips him of both names.
timeline.quote: Ugin then took away both of Bolas's names and rendered the fallen one nameless.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin declares himself Bolas's jailer for eternity and spreads himself over the realm, making it a prison for both.
timeline.quote: The Realm thus became an eternal prison for Bolas and Ugin alike.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the realm the group meets the two sealed elder dragons; Ugin berates Jace while the nameless Bolas seeks a chance to regain power.
timeline.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and casts a spell to reshape the realm; unable to sustain it, he shatters like glass as reality unmakes.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas kills Ugin on the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: they returned to the Meditation Realm, where Bolas killed Ugin

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Confrontation on the Meditation Plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas learns of Azor and Ugin's plan to imprison him.
timeline.quote: Bolas discovered the plan thanks to Azor leaving hints of himself on the planes that he had ordered.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Defeating Ugin again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats Ugin on Tarkir with Yasova's help, leading to the Khanfall.
timeline.quote: Bolas was finally able to defeat the Spirit Dragon when he and Yasova turned Ugin's own lesser dragons against him.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Defeating Ugin again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time and saves Ugin in a hedron cocoon.
timeline.quote: saved Ugin by encasing him in a hedron cocoon immediately after the battle ended

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Defeating Ugin again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin has Jace create an illusion of Bolas's death and takes Bolas away.
timeline.quote: Jace reluctantly complied, fooling the other planeswalkers long enough for Ugin to planeswalk into Ravnica undetected and then planeswalk out with Bolas in tow.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Nameless and imprisoned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin strips Bolas of both his names and imprisons him in the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: Ugin then informed Bolas that he had lost the use of both his names so that he couldn't be summoned by another being ever again.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Nameless and imprisoned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin becomes Bolas's jailer for the rest of his mortal life.
timeline.quote: Ugin told his brother that he'd become his jailer for the remainder of Bolas's mortal life

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Nameless and imprisoned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Having allied with Ugin, Niv-Mizzet had made a device to preserve his spirit, which Sarkhan Vol delivers to the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Having allied with Ugin , Niv-Mizzet created a device to preserve his spirit after death.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas is desparked and sealed away by Jace and Ugin.
timeline.quote: he was desparked himself and sealed away by Jace and Ugin .

citation.text: "Planeswalker spark", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra reactivates the Immortal Sun and leaves Saheeli to guard it; after Bolas's defeat Saheeli disables it again on Jace's unknown plan to let Ugin and Liliana leave.
timeline.quote: After Bolas' defeat, Saheeli disabled the Immortal Sun for a second time.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan helps Ugin bypass Bolas's wards and retrieves Niv's ghost box for the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: He delivered the " ghost box" to the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas kills Ugin, finds the Spirit-Gem in the Meditation Realm and claims it, wearing it for millennia.
timeline.quote: Bolas found the gem in the Meditation Realm after killing his brother Ugin

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin speaks through the Gem to Araithia and appears to Liliana, telling her she must choose her path to redemption.
timeline.quote: Ugin briefly spoke through the Gem to Araithia Shokta and appeared to Liliana Vess

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Holding the Gem and the Chain Veil, Liliana sees the Gem glow and disappear; she drops the Veil and the Gem returns to Ugin.
timeline.quote: The Gem returned to Ugin.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They meet the sealed elder dragons; Ugin berates Jace while the nameless dragon that had been Bolas looks for an opportunity.
timeline.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace secretly steals the Spirit-Gem from behind Ugin and casts a reality-altering spell.
timeline.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole the Spirit-Gem.

citation.text: "Spirit-Gem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas is defeated and Ugin imprisons him on the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas is defeated and thought dead by all but Jace Beleren , while Ugin in reality imprisons him on the Meditation Plane .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the Meditation Plane Ugin lets Bolas fatally wound him, shattering the plane and casting Bolas into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Ugin returned to the Meditation Realm and allowed his brother to fatally wound him.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Confrontation on the Meditation Plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin is reborn as a Spirit Dragon in a body formed from the Realm's waters.
timeline.quote: Ugin awakened, his spirit inhabiting a new body formed from the Meditation Realm's waters.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Confrontation on the Meditation Plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin conspires with Sarkhan, retakes the Meditation Realm and gains a way to spy through the Spirit-Gem on Bolas.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan helped Ugin bypass the wards that Bolas used to protect the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin allies with Niv-Mizzet to plan his resurrection after Bolas kills him.
timeline.quote: Ugin allied with the Ravnican dragon Niv-Mizzet .

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin sends Sarkhan for Hazoret's spear, which the resurrected Niv uses to impale Bolas before Bontu harvests his sparks.
timeline.quote: This enabled the God -Eternal Bontu to deliver the fatal blow

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin takes Bolas's body to the Meditation Realm and has Jace conceal it with an illusion.
timeline.quote: Ugin took his brother's body to the Meditation Realm to prevent him from coming back to life on Ravnica.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas wakes powerless and nameless; Ugin merges his essence with the sealed Meditation Realm to watch him until his natural death.
timeline.quote: He'd also sealed the plane off from the rest of the multiverse

citation.text: "Ugin", section "The End". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin speaks to Araithia and Liliana through the Spirit-Gem, and Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin takes Bolas' body to the Meditation Realm and has Jace create an illusion of the corpse disintegrating.
timeline.quote: Ugin arrives to bring Bolas' body to the Meditation Realm to prevent him from coming back to life on Ravnica.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he orchestrated Bolas' defeat with Niv-Mizzet and Sarkhan, and merges with the Meditation Realm, sealing it with Bolas inside.
timeline.quote: Ugin expands himself throughout the plane, revealing that he's merged his essence with the Meditation Realm.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that the hedrons' purpose is to imprison the Eldrazi; Jace asks how that worked out last time.
timeline.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned." "And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

citation.text: Hedron Archive (Commander 2019, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ugin encourages Liliana to choose a better path.
timeline.quote: At that moment, Ugin appeared to Liliana and encouraged her to choose a better path in her journey ahead.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin lure the Eldrazi; a titan destroys the Sejiri Skyclave.
timeline.quote: one of the titans destroyed the Sejiri Skyclave with a single flick of a tentacle

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The fall of the Skyclaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov tells Ugin he lies entombed with the corpses of worlds to join him.
timeline.quote: "Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."

citation.text: Bitter Revelation (Commander Legends, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that the hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin.

citation.text: Hedron Archive (Time Spiral Remastered, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
